decision_requested: Whether the manufacturing workstream may consider explicitly observed internal state/time-unrolled nodes in a separate namespace, while preserving the original benchmark and broad structural-error/decision question
hard_condition_before_any_structure_scor: Define a finite node/time/edge-pair universe and justify parent closure, excluded/uncertain relations, identification assumptions and matching discovery estimand. A conditional scalar update is not a complete discovery GT.
before_learning_or_effect_experiment: versioned finite reference/uncertainty and matching method contract
predeclared policy/reset/noise/horizon and held-out do estimand
independent evidence review of causal interpretation
external_review_topics_not_new_approval_: dynamic latent projection and finite history sufficiency
deterministic update vs statistical discovery identifiability
independent graph/task units and intervention policy
deliverable_after_scope_decision: One bounded research protocol stating testable and untestable hypotheses, reference semantics and stop conditions; no additional routine smoke or automatic data generation
if_scope_not_approved: Preserve TEP benchmark evaluation as descriptive structure evidence and retain synthetic mechanism findings separately; do not imply manufacturing hypothesis verification
